commands.name: core-wheel-canary
core-wheel-identity
command:
import inspektorium as package, sys, pathlib, json, hashlib, importlib.metadata as metadata
origin = pathlib.Path(package.__file__).resolve()
print(json.dumps({"version": metadata.version('inspektorium'), "runtime_version": package.__version__,
 "site_packages": "site-packages" in origin.parts, "inside_venv": origin.is_relative_to(pathlib.Path(sys.prefix).resolve()),
 "modules": {str(f.relative_to(origin.parent)): hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
             for f in origin.parent.rglob("*.py")}}))
